[gentle][happy] Look at how far you've come... I'm so proud of you.

[sad][whisper] Can we just stay like this a little longer?

[sad][gentle] I know it hurts... I'm right here though.
[amused][chuckle] You really thought you could sneak that past me, huh?

[playful] Last one to the beach has to buy ice cream!
[tender][happy] You know what I love? The way your eyes crinkle when you smile really big.

[tender] I'll always choose you... on the easy days and the hard ones too.
[happy] You singing in the shower is the best alarm clock I've ever had, seriously.
